Horizon Investment Services Position in Intel (INTC) Has Increased by $1.62 Million as Market Valuation Rose; Kemnay Advisory Services Has Cut Position in Microsoft (MSFT) as Market Value Rose

Horizon Investment Services Llc increased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 479.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Horizon Investment Services Llc bought 35,318 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 42,680 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.97M, up from 7,362 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Horizon Investment Services Llc who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $249.45B market cap company. The stock increased 0.38% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $53.53. About 13.53 million shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
